skills.skill: Estimate the square root of a non-perfect-square between two consecutive whole numbers

misconceptions.pattern: Estimates the square root by halving the number instead of finding the whole number whose square is just below it (places √50 near 25 rather than between 7 and 8).

strategies.intent: List the perfect squares and find the two that the number falls between (49 and 64 for 50); the square roots of those squares (7 and 8) bracket the answer, and the smaller one is the lower bound.
